Vacancy for Tutor in Microbiology
Saturday, 06 May 2023
4068 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned post in the Department of Microbiology, MGIMS, Sevagram which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
12/05/2023
. Those who have applied for the post should appear in the personal interview to be held on 13/05/2023 at 11.00 am in the Dean Office.
Tutor: 3 posts:
M.Sc. in Medical Microbiology from a recognized Institute is required.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit:
Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate / between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit. Experience can be relaxed for exceptionally good candidate.
2. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
